preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root must be a TreeNode or None.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == original_val + sum_greater for node, original_val, sum_greater in zip(inorder_traversal(modify(root)), original_inorder_traversal(root), sum_of_greater_values(root)))
postconditions.description: Each node's value in the modified BST is the sum of its original value and the sum of all greater values in the original BST.
